uncited: The core mechanism applies the change of variables formula to the rendering integral $I(\theta) = \int_{\Omega_\theta} f(x, \theta) dx$.

In Monte Carlo estimation, this is implemented by sampling points $\omega$ from a fixed distribution $p(\omega)$ on $\Omega$, mapping them to $x = T(\omega, \theta)$, and weighting by the Jacobian determinant $\left| \det \frac{\partial T}{\partial \omega} \right|$.
- **Formula**: The combined estimator is derived by plugging the Monte Carlo-based estimator (Equation 5) into the volume rendering estimator (Equation 3).
